song._说明: 2026-11-03 用户选「按原歌结构重做」：照中文儿歌《拔萝卜》（「拔萝卜，拔萝卜，嘿哟嘿哟拔萝卜，嘿哟嘿哟拔不动」，一般标佚名、50 年代，按中国法律佚名作品保护期已过）的结构填英文词，旋律尽量贴原调。不用任何现成录音和编曲。上一版原创旋律见 git e6801a3。file/words 由 song.py pick 写进来。
styles: an English-lyrics version of the traditional Chinese children's folk song Ba Luobo (Pulling the Radish), following its well-known simple bouncy pentatonic melody, phrase shapes and heave-ho rhythm as closely as possible
2/4 march-like bounce, a moderate cheerful tempo a toddler can sing along to
warm, smiling, expressive female lead vocal singing to a toddler and having fun
a small group of happy kids joining on every heave-ho, heave-ho
guzheng and pipa plucks, little wood block, ukulele, xylophone, hand claps and light drums
slow, clear English pronunciation with crisp consonants, every word easy to hear
every Pull sung as a clear English word with a ringing L at the end, never Po or Ho

sections.name: Intro
sections.direction: instrumental intro playing the first phrase of the melody on guzheng and xylophone, kids shout Heave-ho! at the end

sections.name: Look
sections.direction: a bright, wide-eyed spoken-sung Look! then A big radish! full of wonder

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.direction: the main tune: Pull the radish, pull the radish, then kids join on heave-ho, heave-ho, pull the radish!

sections.name: Verse 1b
sections.direction: heave-ho, heave-ho, it won't come out! with a funny droop, then a bright call Bun, Bun, come and help!

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.direction: same tune again, a little stronger, ending on a funny drooping it won't come out!

sections.name: Call
sections.direction: Pip, Pip, come and help! then Me too! Me too! tiny, high and squeaky like an eager little mouse

sections.name: Verse 3
sections.direction: same tune, the strongest yet with all the kids, one, two, three! climbing higher on each number

sections.name: Pop
sections.direction: one loud crisp Pop! on the downbeat, Out it comes! bright, everyone cheers Hooray, Pip!

sections.name: Chorus
sections.direction: everyone sings the tune together, big and joyful, ending with a cheering hooray!

sections.name: Tag
sections.direction: light and playful: only Crunch, crunch! in two crisp short notes, then Yummy radish! clearly, nothing else in this section

sections.name: Outro
sections.direction: slow and very clear: Pull! Help! Big! one word per beat, each word held long and sung cleanly, then a soft guzheng ding
